Senses.Explanation: To turn left and turn right records motion in both directions. Zihu Lizong asks Liu Tiemo which way she turns; she answers that he should not turn things upside down. Yuanwu Keqin later raises their exchange. A collected verse on Zhaozhou’s turning of the Diamond Sutra joins left-and-right turning to a sword and to the whole and half canon. Liao’an Qingyu compares the movement to a pearl rolling on a tray, and Hongzhi Zhengjue comments on the Zihu–Liu Tiemo exchange with the same pair.
